verdict.rationale: jo is itself a personal AI agent, so it sits in the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents via an MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows jo running as an MCP server: the llms.txt and OpenAPI spec describe its own surfaces and backend API, not an MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
